results.statement: The ATM task of a dev or fix bead must stay open after the dev's close hook runs and must be closed only by the sanity close hook on PASS, as the lead; the dev waits for that close or for the sanity-fail message and starts no other task meanwhile.
results.quote: I would NOT close the atm task until AFTER sanity is green.  This simplifies the dev<->sanity loop.  in the atm-task-close hook for sanity, if sanity pass, THEN atm task is closed (and dev can begin on next task in the queue), sanity task is closed
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18: Rand's close-hook and mechanical-assignment rulings (atm-core #1873 comment 1, atm-bd-orchestration #340, PR #342)
results.deterministic_check: grep atm-task-close.py: no atm task close completed in the dev or fix role; the sanity PASS branch closes the checked bead's task with the lead identity; atm task events of a dev task show the close after the sanity PASS
results.explanation: This bead proposes something the anchor rules out.
